headline: Western Digital Earnings Beat With 44% Sales Growth. But Stock Tumbles Late.
summary: Western Digital stock slid late Wednesday despite the hard-disk drive maker reporting fiscal fourth-quarter results ahead of estimates.  Western Digital, which recently rebranded as WD, said its adjusted earnings climbed 109% to $3.56 per share for the June quarter.  WD and its rival Seagate Technology dominate the hard-disk drive market.

headline: Western Digital forecasts upbeat revenue but shares fall on lofty expectations
summary: Western Digital forecast quarterly revenue slightly above Wall Street estimates on Wednesday, betting ‌on strong AI-driven demand for its hard disk ‌drives. Still, its shares dropped more than 9% in extended trading, after ​the forecast failed to impress investors even though the stock has tripled this year on expectations of sustained AI-driven growth. Memory and storage stocks have soared this year as ‌investors bet data-center ⁠demand will support pricing and fuel growth across the industry.

headline: Western Digital (NASDAQ:WDC) Surprises With Q2 Sales But Stock Drops 10%
summary: Leading data storage manufacturer Western Digital (NASDAQ: WDC) reported Q2 CY2026 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 43.8% year on year to $3.75 billion. Guidance for next quarter’s revenue was better than expected at $4.1 billion at the midpoint, 1.5% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $3.56 per share was 7.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
